verdict.rationale: Stagehand's first-party docs describe observe() as a primitive that discovers actionable elements on the current page and returns structured actions you can execute or validate before acting. That is exactly the preview-before-commit workflow in the story. Caching of observe() results and v4's explicit, non-autonomous orchestration reinforce that the developer decides when to act. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of observe(), and detail on the returned action format and on handing observed actions to act().
